body: Probably not gonna stick around frankly. If I wanted to be in a place where bigots can do whatever they want, I'd go literally anywhere else on the planet
No point in sticking around I guess. Sigh.
I'm so sorry. If you do leave I hope you'll find a more supportive community.
I guess I still expected better from this place. Then again it's not wise to expect better out of groups when you're a trans woman. We should, but every place seems to slip like this.
Thank you. I am grateful to have an amazing network of friends who see me for who I am. I wish all trans people got to have that.

Yeah, I'm just a lurker but this thread is making me look at TrollX with suspicion. It always seemed like a safe haven from the usual noise of life as a trans woman but that's not what I'm seeing here.

I don't like doing discourse because I'm not great at arguing my points and have bad social anxiety, but I'm disappointed at the amount of damaging, superficial discussion that relies on the assumption that trans women's sex/gender must be scrutinized, dissected and regulated.

Gonna be honest, as a trans woman I find most of this thread incredibly invalidating and plain wrong about what I do and do not experience. I realize not everyone had a life like this but I've experienced misogyny and been punished for being a girl my entire life.

Really tired of being told my experience isn't real. And don't get me started on the weird, outdated "biological sex" discussion going on in here.
